def clean(s):
 s=re.sub(r'\\(["'^)]*confidence[''^)]*'"\\)','',s)
 return re.sub(r'\\b(high|medium|low) confidence\\b','',s,flags=re.I)
v=TfidfVectorizer(stop_words='english',ngram_range=(1,2),max_df=.85,sublinear_tf=True)
x=v.fit_transform([r['caption'] for r in b])
q=v.transform([clean(r['caption']['summaries']['w200']+' '+r['caption']['global']['landscape']) for r in t])
a=cosine_similarity(q,x)
print('Bank count:',len(b))
for i in range(len(t)):
 print('\\nTARGET',i)
 for j in a[i].argsort()[-3:][::-1]: print(b[j]['bank_id'],round(a[i,j],3),b[j]['caption'])
PY"
